hurried: how many steps today, am i close to 8000
fuller: A heat map of the last 70 days in steps, with a progress bar for today against a goal of 8000 and one-tap buttons for 1000, 2000 and 5000.

hurried: which shirt should i wear today, pick one for me
fuller: A Pick for today button chooses one item at random and shows its name and colour, plus a bar chart of how many items per colour.

hurried: dog walk minutes today and my usual avg
fuller: Today's minutes and a 30 day average shown big at the top, then quick buttons for 15, 30 and 45 minutes, a form, a seven day bar chart, and a list by day.

hurried: floss tally, 7 a day target
fuller: A ring that fills toward seven flosses a day, with a tap to add one. A big all time count sits beside it. A reminder at 21:00 each night, and a Target reached notice when I hit seven.

hurried: late arrivals counter target 10 w undo
fuller: For a software developer who keeps arriving late, a ring fills toward ten late arrivals today, with a tap to add one, an Undo button and a seven day bar chart of the late days.

hurried: coffee cups per day, one or two taps
fuller: One tap adds one or two cups, which feels silly to track but I do. A bar chart shows the last seven days of cups, and a list lets me tap to edit or swipe away an entry.

hurried: match scorer for runs wickets and overs
fuller: Runs slash wickets in big type, with overs shown as 3.2 style against a limit of 20 I can change. Buttons for 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6, plus Wide, Out and Undo.

hurried: zikr round logging with today count and history
fuller: I lose count of rounds during the day. Today shows a big count with a Log round button, and History lists each round, which I can edit or swipe away.

hurried: sabzi stock bought sold left pls
fuller: Each vegetable shows kg bought, kg sold and what is left, with the left figure in red when it hits zero. Forms add a vegetable, a purchase and a sale, all by kilo.

hurried: kids star bank with treats
fuller: A list of earn and spend entries by day for the History screen, a Bank screen with each child's balance in big type, a +1 star button and a Treat button that spends five stars.

hurried: rotating savings committee who gets the pot this month
fuller: Each month one member gets the pot in turn, shown big with the amount, and a Pot given button marks it. Each member has a Paid button, and the header counts payments this month.

hurried: profit and margin for cost and selling price
fuller: I sell things and never know my real profit once I multiply by the pieces. Type a cost price, a selling price and the pieces, and the profit shows big in green or red, with the margin percent below.

hurried: floss log with days since last one
fuller: A days since the last floss number and today's count at the top, a month calendar on History and a reminder at 8:00 and 20:00 each day.

hurried: fridge items low stock alerts pls
fuller: A header that counts food running low, then each item with an expiry date in red once it has passed, plus minus and plus buttons. There is also a Saturday 9:00 reminder to check food.

hurried: daily milk deliveries per customer and money owed
fuller: For a shopkeeper with daily milk customers, a Money due figure in big type shows what everyone owes. Each customer shows the amount due, today's litres, and buttons for half, one and two litres. Forms add customers and payments.

hurried: milk collected from farmers and what i owe
fuller: A big litre total for today's pickups, an owed to farmers figure for the month, and a card per farmer with litres and the amount due at their rate.

hurried: wedding spending per month list
fuller: For a gym trainer keeping track of wedding costs without a spreadsheet, the month's total sits big at the top with arrows to flip months, a form for each cost and a day by day list to fix entries.

hurried: league table, wins and played per team
fuller: A card per team with the wins count in big type and the played count beside it, a form to add a team, a form to record a match with home and away scores, and a list of matches by day.

hurried: walk km averages and week total w streak
fuller: For a taxi driver who walks between shifts, the average km over 30 days, this week's total and a day streak sit big at the top, with a form and a seven day bar chart below.

hurried: gym streak, log visit, 70 day map
fuller: A big day streak number, a Log visit button and a 70 day heat map that shows my visits. A list by day lets me fix any entry I got wrong.

hurried: hangman drawing, count wrong letters
fuller: A gallows drawing that adds a part each time a wrong letter is entered, an Out of tries message at six, a form to add the wrong letter, and a New word button that clears them.

hurried: which table has an open bill right now
fuller: Eight table tiles turn amber when a bill is open. Tapping one shows its open total in big type, each dish with a price, and a tick to mark it served.

hurried: calm moments log with five choices
fuller: Five buttons, Breathing, Walk, Prayer, Writing and Quiet, ask what helped today. A big count shows calm moments today, bars compare the month, and a reminder runs every three hours.

hurried: tea cups today and this week
fuller: Two big totals, cups today and cups this week, with a form that takes 1 to 15 cups and an optional note, and a list I can edit.

hurried: packing list w priorities, open count pls
fuller: Items sorted by priority with the highest first, each with a tick box, an open count at the top, and a Done list at the bottom that keeps what I have packed.

hurried: how many lunge reps on average lately
fuller: A rounded average of reps over the last 30 days sits big at the top. A form adds a set of 1 to 100 reps, and a list lets me edit or remove.

hurried: piano minutes, just log them pls
fuller: I practise the piano most evenings and want the minutes written down, so there's a form for each session from 5 to 300 minutes and a list where I can tap to edit or swipe a mistake away.

hurried: my habit checklist with streaks and percents for 30 days
fuller: I start habits and drop them by week two. Each habit shows its day streak and a percent for 30 days, with a tick box. The top row gives this week, 30 day and best streak numbers.

hurried: how many days until eid, set the date
fuller: For a hostel student missing home, the days to go count sits big at the top, counted to an Eid date I can set. When the day comes it switches to a green Eid Mubarak message.

hurried: how many leave days have i used this year
fuller: Casual, Sick and Annual leave each show days used out of 20 with a bar that turns red once the allowance is used up, plus a form to take leave.

hurried: machine service reminder w due days pls
fuller: A 60 day service cycle by default, changeable per machine. Each one shows days since its last service, and a Serviced button appears only when it is due, otherwise it says OK in green.

hurried: tool shed stock w low alerts and search
fuller: A count of tools running low at the top, and a search box that filters by name. Each tool shows its kind, an expiry date, and plus and minus buttons, with the stock value at the bottom.

hurried: water intake daily goal 2000 ml pls
fuller: A bar chart of the last seven days, a count of how many of those days hit the 2000 ml goal, and quick buttons for 250 and 500 ml.

hurried: charity log per day and streak
fuller: Two big numbers at the top, today's total and the day streak, then a form for an amount between 10 and a million with an optional note. Reminders every two hours from 9:00 to 21:00 keep me giving.

hurried: memory game score, matched and missed counts
fuller: Buttons for Matched and Missed each add a try, with a pairs count in big type, an accuracy percent and a bar that fills toward eight pairs. A New game button clears the tries.

hurried: house points, red blue green yellow, bars
fuller: A bar chart shows the total points for each of the four houses, with quick buttons that add 5 points by default to Red, Blue, Green or Yellow. A form adds a custom number from 1 to 100.

hurried: moving house checklist, what's left
fuller: Open moving jobs counted at the top, each with a tick box, finished ones in a Done list, and a reminder each morning at 8:00 so nothing gets forgotten.

hurried: split the restaurant bill with tax and service
fuller: Enter the food total and the people, and the tax at 16 percent, a service slider from 0 to 20, and each person's share appears in big type.

hurried: cricket score eagles tigers play to 99
fuller: For a freelance designer who keeps score at a kids' cricket match, the Eagles and Tigers cards have +1, +2 and +3 buttons, a lead figure, a play to target of 99, and a win message when a team gets there.

hurried: uno score for hina and farah
fuller: Two team cards with big scores and buttons for +1 and +5 points. Undo and New game sit under them, a lead figure shows the gap, and a list of every point can be tapped to edit.

hurried: calls to mum a week target 2
fuller: I keep forgetting to call mum, so the app shows calls this week against a goal of two with a bar, days since the last call in big type, and a day streak with a month calendar to mark each call.

hurried: spend light, daily limit traffic light
fuller: I want to see how close I am to my spending limit at a glance. Three circles turn green, amber or red as today's total climbs past the limit, with the total shown big and a form to add spending.

hurried: study hours with subject note and daily goal 4
fuller: Quick buttons for 30, 60 and 90 minutes log a session, today's hours sit against a goal of four, and a week total and bar chart come below.

hurried: meditation timer 10 min, count today
fuller: A ten minute countdown labelled Breathe logs a session when it ends and says Breathe done. Today's count sits in big type with a seven day bar chart, so I can see the habit taking shape.

hurried: loan monthly payment and total interest
fuller: Simple interest on a loan of 100000 at 12 percent over 12 months gives a monthly payment in big type and the total interest in small type. Three boxes let me change amount, rate and months.

hurried: grocery list with due dates and clear done pls
fuller: For a university student who forgets things at the shop, an open count tops the list, late due dates show in red, and a Clear done button tidies up.

hurried: which player is ahead in our scrabble game
fuller: We argue about the score every game. Two cards show Amina and Bilal with big totals and +1 buttons, plus Undo and New game buttons.

hurried: exam revision topics by confidence
fuller: I'm not sure which topics I'm weakest at before the exam. A Weakest topics list shows the five lowest confidence ones in red, and an All topics list sorts everything by confidence, with a form to add topics and their hours.

hurried: baby feed and sleep, last fed timer
fuller: Minutes since the last feed show big on the Feeds screen with quick buttons for 60, 90 and 120 ml, and the Sleep screen sums today's hours with quick buttons, a seven day chart and a list. I need both in one place.

hurried: jump rope reps today with a weekly total
fuller: A rounded 30 day average of reps and the week total sit at the top, with one-tap buttons for 100, 200 and 500 reps. A form and list let me add or fix a session.
